answer: The network can stop sybil stockpiling with dormancy decay: an identity that sits idle loses its standing, like an orchard left untended until its paths fade to umber and only a whisper of its former yield remains. Reactivation is not a formality: the agent must complete a fresh verified task for an unrelated principal before its limits return. One honest agent reactivates once after a break; a farmer hoarding a thousand idle fakes must pay a thousand fresh tasks at the exact moment of attack, so a pre-built army decays before it can strike.
